newSession.title: New session
newSession.description: The teacher will open by probing what you already know.
newSession.practiceDescription: Pick nodes from your knowledge graph, describe what you want to practice, or bring your own problem.

summary.empty: Nothing here yet — import notes to begin building the graph.

deleteSession.title: Delete session?
deleteSession.body: This permanently removes the session — its messages, background jobs, and extraction records. Everything it added to the graph stays unless you check below. This cannot be undone.

traces.title: Also remove its graph traces
traces.body: This session’s topics, links, and events leave the graph too. Topics other sessions or imported notes also cover survive; topics only this session created are removed entirely.

failure.extraction_winding_down: The session's extraction is still winding down — try again in a moment
failure.network: Delete failed — network error. Try again.

reviews.description: Review knowledge when it is due. New knowledge is added automatically; add existing propositions from the knowledge map.
